Misc. No. 415/38.

B'well
8th. October, 38.

1.

Re. bomb thrown in the Ziang Sung ( 祥 生 ) Gambling House, No.17, Lane 957 Jessfield Road (Chinese territory).
----------------------------------------

At 7.20p.m. 8/10/38, a telephone message was received at Bubbling Well Station from C.C.R. reporting that a bomb had been thrown on Jessfield Road near Brenan Road and that the S.F. Brigade Emergency Ambulance was attending.

The station alarm was rung and a party of Police under S.I. Daintry attended. On arriving at the scene it was ascertained that at about 7p.m. above date, a bomb was thrown in the Ziang Sung ( 祥 生 ) gambling house, No. 17, Lane 957 Jessfield Road. (In Chinese territory about twenty yards from the Municipal Roadway).

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH）

Seven male Chinese were injured by the explosion and were conveyed by the S.F. Brigade Emergency Ambulance to the Red Cross Hospital, No. 363 Avenue Haig where they were certified to be suffering from the following respective injuries:

(1) Multiple shell wounds of both lower limbs.
(2) Compound fracture of left tibia.
(3) Shell wound of left foot.
(4) Shell wounds of both legs.
(5) Shell wounds of legs.
(6) Compound fracture of right tibia.
(7) Shell wound of left leg.

（批：C 12 ... 26 ...）
（批：DCSB. ... 9/10.）
A to D. C. (Sp. Br.)

杂项编号：415/38。

静安寺
1938年10月8日。

1.

关于在极司菲尔路（Jessfield Road）957弄17号祥生赌馆（中国地界）内投掷炸弹一事。
---

1938年10月8日下午7时20分，静安寺巡捕房从中央无线电接收室（C.C.R.）接到电话报告，称极司菲尔路靠近布伦南路（Brenan Road）附近有人投掷炸弹，万国商团急救救护车正在现场处置。

巡捕房拉响警报，由警佐丹特里（Daintry）率领一队警员前往。抵达现场后查明，在上述日期的下午7时许，一枚炸弹被投掷进位于极司菲尔路957弄17号的祥生赌馆。（该处位于中国地界，距工部局道路约二十码）。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处特科）

七名中国男子在爆炸中受伤，由万国商团急救救护车送往海格路（Avenue Haig）363号红十字会医院，经诊断分别患有以下伤情：

(1) 双下肢多处弹片伤。
(2) 左胫骨开放性骨折。
(3) 左脚弹片伤。
(4) 双腿弹片伤。
(5) 腿部弹片伤。
(6) 右胫骨开放性骨折。
(7) 左腿弹片伤。

（批注：C 12 ... 26 ...）
（批注：DCSB ____ 10月9日。）
致 D. C.（特科）

pages.en:
Miss. No. 415/38.

1/sheet 2.

The gambling house manager, one Zee Ah Eur(齋阿安),
told detectives that on 24/9/38 he received an anonymous
letter the writer of which demanded the sum of $10,000.00
and threatened to throw a bomb in the gambling house if
the money was not paid.

The case is being investigated by the Ta Tao Police.
Forwarded for information.

Informed:- Inspt. i/c.
           Sen. Det.
           D.O. "B" Div.

杂项编号：415/38。

第1页/共2页。

该赌馆经理斋阿安（Zee Ah Eur）告诉侦探，他在1938年9月24日收到一封匿名信，写信人索要美金10,000.00元，并威胁若不付款将在赌馆内投掷炸弹。

此案正由大道政府警察局调查。
